user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend and I need help with the preparations.

TaskList.description: Research and select an event planning tool that offers features for creating guest lists, sending invitations, and managing RSVPs.
Use the selected event planning tool to create a guest list for the party.
Send out invitations to the guests using the event planning tool.
Set up RSVP management through the event planning tool to track guest responses.
Research and select a music streaming platform that allows users to create and share playlists.
Create a personalized playlist for the party using the selected music streaming platform.
